property_summary: For any caller that is the current owner and any newOwner address, after calling transferOwnership(newOwner) the contract's owner getter equals newOwner; the mutant that clears owner to address(0) breaks this by leaving owner == address(0) for some newOwner inputs.
change_summary: Added an extra assignment that sets owner to address(0) after setting to newOwner, causing owner to always be cleared at end of call.
